prompt:
The section sections/milestones-timeline.liquid renders a company timeline. Its schema already has a `max_items` range setting, but the markup ignores it and renders every milestone block. Wire it up. Do not change the schema block in any way. Inputs: - section.settings.heading: string, may be null or "". - section.settings.max_items: integer from 1 to 10, never null. - section.blocks: array, may be empty. Each block has block.settings.year (string, never null) and block.settings.title (string, may be null or ""). Required output, with no whitespace between tags: - `
` ... `
`. - If heading is neither null nor "", output `

HEADING

` first, with the heading HTML-escaped. Otherwise output no h2. - Next, always output `
    ` ... `
`, even when it ends up empty. - The new rule: consider only the first max_items blocks, counted by position in section.blocks. Ignore all later blocks. - Among the considered blocks, skip any block whose title is null or "". Skipped blocks still count toward max_items. Do not pull in later blocks to make up the number. - For each remaining block, in order, output `
  • YEAR TITLE
    • `. There is exactly one space between `` and the title. Year and title are both HTML-escaped with the standard escape filter. Example: with max_items 3 and titles ["Founded", "", "First store", "Online shop"], only Founded and First store are rendered. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/milestones-timeline.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
